description:
X-Men Forever 2 #3 (July 2010), Marvel Comics - "Of Sentinels, Spiders and Southern Belles!" Nightcrawler and Spider-Man vs. a Sentinel. Chris Claremont story; Tom Grummett pencils and cover, Cory Hamscher inks. Direct edition, $3.99 cover price.

Back cover: Phineas and Ferb: Summer Belongs to You! (Disney XD) ad.

Condition: bright with light handling wear; small blemish at the bottom left of the back cover (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
